1. Clinical Course & Microbiology Review:
- Urgent Care (2024-05-29): Presented with 3 days of a red, hot, swollen right elbow overlying a small abrasion, fever (38.4 C), tachycardia (HR 104), leukocytosis (WBC 14.2 x10^3/uL), and elevated CRP (92 mg/L). Right olecranon bursa aspiration yielded 14 mL of purulent fluid (WBC 58,000/uL, Gram-positive cocci in clusters, no crystals). Two sets of blood cultures were drawn prior to antibiotics, and he was started on oral cephalexin 500 mg QID.
- Culture Results (2024-06-01): Both right olecranon bursal fluid culture and 2 of 2 sets of peripheral blood cultures grew Methicillin-Susceptible Staphylococcus aureus (MSSA; penicillin-resistant, cefoxitin screen negative, susceptible to clindamycin, doxycycline, and TMP-SMX).
